item.title: Jim Bakker, who built 'PTL Club' televangelism empire, has died at 86
item.description: Jim Bakker, along with his first wife Tammy Faye built an evangelical empire around the hugely successful "The PTL Club" TV show, only to lose it all over a sex scandal and financial crimes.

item.title: No one expected Leo to be pope — except everyone who knew him as 'Bob'
item.description: When the 2025 conclave began, no one expected an American pope. But by its end, Cardinal Robert Prevost had become Pope Leo. Here's a look behind the scenes.

item.title: Papal pilgrimage: Pope Leo fills Place de la Concorde for historic Mass in France
item.description: On the second day of his four-day visit to France, Pope Leo celebrates Mass in Paris at the Place de la Concorde. He's being greeted like a rock star in this traditionally Catholic yet staunchly secular nation.

item.title: Catholic media star Archbishop Fulton Sheen beatified
item.description: The Catholic Bishop of Rochester, New York, Fulton Sheen, moves one step closer to sainthood with his beatification. Sheen is best known for hosting radio and television programs for over four decades.

item.description: In the first papal state visit to France in nearly 20 years, Pope Leo will preside over Mass in Paris, meet with sex abuse survivors and deliver a speech on European unity.

item.title: A Catholic media star was beatified in St. Louis, moving a step closer to sainthood
item.description: Bishop Fulton Sheen will be beatified by the Catholic Church in St. Louis on Thursday, moving the television personality from the 1950s one step away from sainthood.
